facts.text: New Jersey students with a family adjusted gross income of $65,000 or less have tuition and fees covered through Pledge 4 Success and the Garden State Guarantee.

sources.title: Tuition-Free Opportunities | William Paterson University
sources.quote: For New Jersey students with a family adjusted gross income of $65,000 or less, these programs will cover the cost of tuition and fees that are not already paid by federal and state financial aid or other scholarships.
